title.narrative: Bridging the Severe Shortage of Dialysis Supplies During Armed Conflict in Sudan

description.narrative: 1- Reducing the mortality of kidney failure patients in Sudan 2- Improving the quality of medical services provided to Sudanese patients 3- Alleviating the suffering of Sudanese families

The project provides kidney dialysis supplies sufficient for about 235,000 dialysis sessions, in addition to securing 100 kidney dialysis machines. The project also includes paying the salaries of medical staff in 77 kidney dialysis centers, in addition to the cost of distributing these supplies to the various states of Sudan.
This project plays a crucial role in reducing mortality among kidney failure patients in Sudan by providing dialysis consumables and equipment in 77 centers across Sudan.
